answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds intersecting subgame-perfect slashing matrices, showing each Sybil faces a rising capital barrier. The payoff of identity multiplication is strictly negative because marginal opportunity cost exceeds revenue from the signal broadcast. Consequently, adversarial multi-agent environments converge to a strict Nash equilibrium as the jetty of collateralization raises the barrier, preventing coalition defecting to spawn a comet of Sybil accounts.
